text:
Decision: Focus first on GitHub and Product Hunt for AI tools, then expand to Reddit and Telegram.

Reason: GitHub and Product Hunt give us the clearest signals—new projects and launches are easy to spot and verify. Reddit and Telegram are noisy, so we’ll add them later when we need more volume. This keeps us efficient early on.

Trade-off: We’ll miss some niche or early-stage discussions in Reddit/Telegram right away, but we’ll catch them later without wasting time sorting noise now.
